context: Two teens chat about school after class
purpose: Teach: たしかに/やたら/繰り返す/たいてい/いっしょ/せめて/格好/元々

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今日の数学、たしかに難しすぎたよね。
lines.en: Today's math was definitely too hard, right?
lines.style: Casual teen complaint with rising agreement-seeking tone

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ほんとそれ。先生やたら宿題出すし、もう無理。
lines.en: Seriously. The teacher gives crazy amounts of homework, I can't deal.
lines.style: Exasperated teen venting with casual masculine speech

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 同じミス繰り返すから、たいてい放課後に居残りなんだよね。
lines.en: I keep making the same mistakes, so I usually end up staying after school.
lines.style: Self-deprecating teen confession with light sigh

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: じゃあ今度いっしょに勉強する?せめて宿題だけでも片付けようよ。
lines.en: Then wanna study together next time? At least let's knock out the homework.
lines.style: Friendly teen invitation with encouraging upbeat tone

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 助かる!でもリク、その格好で図書館行くの?
lines.en: That helps! But Riku, you're going to the library dressed like that?
lines.style: Teasing teen surprise with playful giggling tone

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: え、変?元々こういうスタイル好きなんだけど。
lines.en: Huh, is it weird? I've always liked this kind of style though.
lines.style: Defensive teen reply with slight embarrassment and laugh

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ううん、格好いいよ。じゃあ四時に校門で待ち合わせね。
lines.en: Nah, you look cool. Then let's meet at the school gate at four.
lines.style: Warm teen reassurance shifting to brisk planning tone

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: オッケー、絶対遅れないでよ!
lines.style: Cheerful teen sign-off with mock-warning playful energy
